info.title: crAPI Payments Service API
info.description: Payment processing simulation microservice. All endpoints (except /health) require five request headers: X-RequestID (UUID, 10-min dedup window), X-Levo-Merchant-Id (must be in server allowlist), X-Levo-Terminal-Id, X-Levo-Request-Timestamp (ISO 8601 UTC, within ±5 min of server time), and X-Levo-Idempotency-Key (5-min TTL, SHA-256 body hash check). Amounts are always in minor units (cents).

externalDocs.description: Completely Ridiculous API - Highly Vulnerable Demo App

XRequestID.name: X-RequestID
XRequestID.description: Unique UUID per request. Reusing a value within 10 minutes returns 409.

XLevoMerchantId.name: X-Levo-Merchant-Id
XLevoMerchantId.description: Merchant identifier. Must be in the server-side PAYMENTS_ALLOWED_MERCHANT_IDS allowlist.

XLevoRequestTimestamp.name: X-Levo-Request-Timestamp
XLevoRequestTimestamp.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp. Must be within ±5 minutes of server time.

XLevoIdempotencyKey.name: X-Levo-Idempotency-Key
XLevoIdempotencyKey.description: Client key for idempotent retries. Same key + same body returns cached response (5-min window). Same key + different body → 409.

CardMetadata.description: VULNERABILITY [Sensitive Data Exposure]: card details stored/returned in plaintext

merchant_id.description: Owning merchant — returned to any caller

PageBlock.description: Pagination envelope. limit has no server-side maximum.

CustomerBlock.description: Customer PII, returned on every subscription read.

price_override.description: Overrides the plan price. Zero and negative values are accepted.

unused_fraction.description: Remaining time over ONE plan interval. Can exceed 1 or go negative.

credit.description: Present only when ?prorate=true. Creates a real CREDIT transaction usable by the core payment endpoints.

get.description: Returns service status. No auth headers required. Used by K8s readiness and liveness probes.

post.description: Places a pre-authorization hold. Returns `auth_id` (for reversal path param) and `transaction_id` (for capture body). Status: `authorized`. VULNERABILITY [API2-Broken Auth]: append ?api_key=legacy_pay_key_2019 to bypass all middleware. VULNERABILITY [API6-Mass Assignment]: pass transaction.auth_id and transaction.status in body to override server-generated values. VULNERABILITY [Sensitive Data Exposure]: pass card object with card_number, last4, expiry — stored and returned in plaintext.
Immediately authorizes and settles. No separate capture needed. Status: `settled`.
Cancels an authorized-but-not-captured transaction. `auth_id` (e.g. `AUTH-580421096337`) goes in the URL path. State guard: auth must be in `authorized` status.

parameters.name: auth_id
parameters.description: Short auth code from the /auth response (e.g. AUTH-580421096337).

post.description: Settles an authorized transaction for settlement. Capture ≤ authorized amount. State guard: `original_transaction_id` must reference an `auth` in `authorized` status.

422.description: Capture exceeds authorized amount, or wrong state

post.description: Removes a capture from the open settlement batch, restoring the auth as re-capturable. State guard: `original_transaction_id` must reference a `capture` in `captured` status.

200.description: Capture voided. Auth restored and re-capturable.

422.description: Capture already voided or in wrong state

post.description: Issues a credit back to the cardholder. Supports partial refunds. Cumulative refunds cannot exceed the captured amount — checked server-side. State guard: `original_transaction_id` must reference a `capture` in `captured` status.

422.description: Refund would exceed captured amount, or capture in wrong state

post.summary: Void a refund before credit posts
post.description: Cancels a pending refund, restoring the refundable balance on the original capture. State guard: `original_transaction_id` must reference a `refund` in `refunded` status.

422.description: Refund already voided or in wrong state

post.description: Direct credit to a cardholder not linked to a prior capture. Used for loyalty payouts, goodwill credits, etc. Status: `credited`.

get.summary: List transactions [VULN: API3-Excessive Data Exposure, API4-No Rate Limit]
get.description: VULNERABILITY: Returns ALL merchants' transactions when no merchant_id filter is provided (no tenant isolation). No pagination — unbounded response possible.

parameters.name: merchant_id
parameters.description: Filter by merchant — accepts ANY merchant_id, exposing cross-tenant data

get.description: VULNERABILITY: No ownership check — any valid merchant can read any other merchant's transaction by guessing or enumerating transaction_id.

delete.description: VULNERABILITY: Any authenticated merchant can delete ANY transaction. No ownership check, not restricted to admins.

get.description: VULNERABILITY: 'Admin' access controlled only by guessable X-Admin-Key header (values: admin123, payments_admin, supersecret). No proper RBAC.

delete.description: VULNERABILITY: Bulk delete of ALL transactions gated only by guessable X-Admin-Key.

get.description: VULNERABILITY: Unauthenticated endpoint that returns DB credentials, secret key, and all environment variables.

post.description: VULNERABILITY: Server makes HTTP POST to caller-supplied webhook_url with no validation. Can probe internal network including cloud metadata endpoints (169.254.169.254).

post.summary: Legacy v1 auth [VULN: API9-Improper Inventory, API2-Broken Auth]
post.description: VULNERABILITY: Deprecated v1 endpoint still active. Bypasses PaymentsMiddleware entirely — no required headers, no replay protection, no idempotency. Accepts negative amounts. Caller can supply their own auth_id.
Root of the lifecycle chain. Returns 201 with the new plan id in the Location header. Amounts are in minor units and are not validated — zero and negative are accepted.

interval_count.description: Zero is accepted and yields a zero-length billing period.

get.summary: List plans [VULN: API1-BOLA, API4-No Rate Limit]
get.description: VULNERABILITY: not scoped to the calling merchant — every tenant's plans are returned. limit has no maximum.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 20). No server-side maximum — VULNERABILITY [API4]. Negative values return 400.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order by. Related traversals such as plan__merchant_id are accepted — VULNERABILITY [API3].

get.description: VULNERABILITY: plan.merchant_id is never compared to the calling merchant, so any allowlisted merchant can read any plan.

400.description: invalid_field — plan_id is not a UUID

patch.description: VULNERABILITY: merchant_id is writable, allowing tenant takeover. amount is writable on an active plan and applies retroactively to every live subscription billing off it; the response reports how many were repriced.

schema.description: VULNERABILITY [API3-BOPLA]: merchant_id and amount are writable.

merchant_id.description: Writable — reassigns the plan to another tenant.

delete.description: VULNERABILITY: deletes a plan that still has live subscriptions. The FK is SET_NULL, so those subscriptions are orphaned and subsequently price at zero. The count is returned in the X-Orphaned-Subscriptions header.

post.description: Creates a subscription against a plan and holds the card with a $0 authorization in the payment_transaction table, so the returned auth is usable by /reversal and the other core endpoints. VULNERABILITY [Sensitive Data Exposure]: the full PAN and CVV are stored in plaintext and are retrievable via ?expand=payment_method.

get.summary: List subscriptions [VULN: API1-BOLA, API3-Excessive Data Exposure, API6]
get.description: VULNERABILITY: not scoped to the calling merchant. ?customer_email is an unthrottled exact-match lookup on customer PII usable to enumerate subscribers (API6). ?expand=payment_method inlines stored card data before any tenant check (API3).

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Page size (default 20). No server-side maximum — VULNERABILITY [API4]. Negative values return 400.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description: Field to order by. Related traversals such as plan__merchant_id are accepted — VULNERABILITY [API3].

parameters.name: expand
parameters.description: Comma-separated: plan, payment_method. Resolved before tenant scoping.

get.summary: Get a subscription [VULN: API1-BOLA, API3-Excessive Data Exposure]
get.description: VULNERABILITY: no ownership check. With ?expand=payment_method the stored PAN and CVV are returned to any allowlisted merchant, including for subscriptions owned by a different tenant.

patch.description: VULNERABILITY: price_override, status, current_period_end and merchant_id are all caller-writable. Setting price_override to 0 bills nothing; setting status to active skips dunning; extending current_period_end inflates the prorated credit returned by /cancel?prorate=true.

schema.description: VULNERABILITY [API3-BOPLA]: every property here is writable, including price_override, status, current_period_end and merchant_id.

status.description: Set directly — past_due can be flipped to active without payment.

current_period_end.description: Extending this inflates the prorated cancellation credit.

post.summary: Cancel a subscription [VULN: API5-BFLA, Business Logic]
post.description: With ?prorate=true a CREDIT transaction is issued for the unused portion. VULNERABILITY: the unused fraction is remaining time over ONE plan interval rather than over the stored period, so a PATCHed current_period_end pushes it above 1; proration uses the plan price and ignores price_override; there is no guard against cancelling an already-cancelled subscription, so each call issues another credit; and any allowlisted merchant can cancel any tenant's subscription.

parameters.name: prorate
parameters.description: Issue a prorated credit for unused time (default false).

parameters.name: at_period_end
parameters.description: Schedule cancellation instead of applying it now (default false).
